desc: Oatmeal Crisp Crunchy Almond is a hearty, crunchy breakfast cereal blending whole‑grain oat and wheat flakes with almond pieces and sweet clusters. Fortified with essential nutrients, it delivers a filling and flavorful start to the day in a 19.7‑oz box (sold as 6‑pack cases). It's especially loved as a family favorite and accessible source of fiber
features:
High in Whole Grain & Fiber: ~42 g whole grain and 5–6 g dietary fiber per 1‑cup serving—supports digestive health.

Crunchy Almond Clusters: Combines toasted almond slivers and oat clusters for texture and taste.

Heart‑Health Focused: Low saturated fat (around 0.5 g) and cholesterol‑free; plant‑based whole grains help support heart health .

Versatile Use: Ideal with milk or yogurt, and works great in trail mix or homemade granola bars
ingredients: Whole Grain Oats, Whole Grain Wheat, Sugar, Almond Pieces, Corn Syrup, Brown Sugar Syrup, Salt, Rice Flour, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Honey, Maltodextrin, Molasses, Natural Flavor, Barley Malt Extract, Baking Soda, Annatto Extract, Rosemary Extract, Vitamin E (Mixed Tocopherols) and BHT Added to Preserve Freshness. Vitamins and Minerals: Iron (a Mineral Nutrient), a B Vitamin (Niacinamide), a B Vitamin (Calcium Pantothenate), Vitamin B6 (Pyridoxine Hydrochloride), a B Vitamin (Folic Acid).
